name: Certified AI Plant Operations Leader
description: AI for running US plants: production planning, quality, maintenance and safety.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Plant Operations Leader

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Plant Managers and Production Supervisors (MFG-120); Building AI for Production Planning, Scheduling and OEE (MFG-225); Building AI into Quality Management: SPC, CAPA, ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 (MFG-235); AI for Plant Safety and EHS under OSHA (MFG-245). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
